title: Cite the source and know when to refuse
subtitle: Answers with [n] to check, and "I don’t know" when the handbook doesn’t say
mission: Aurora’s HR assistant will answer real employees. Make it cite the chunk behind each answer and refuse when the handbook doesn’t cover the topic, instead of making things up.

predict.question: someone asks the gym’s opening hours, which aren’t in the handbook. With refusal on, the assistant…

options.refuse: Says it couldn’t find it and forwards to HR

feedback.right: right: no chunk passed the confidence threshold, and the refusal instruction says to answer "couldn’t find it". An honest "don’t know" beats made-up hours.
feedback.wrong: with refusal on it says it couldn’t find it and forwards. Without that instruction, the model tends to answer with no basis: the hallucination you’ll trigger at the end.
feedback.skipped: no guess? Run the gym question.

coach.ui: guess noted. Run the gym question; then one from the handbook and look for the [n] at the end.
coach.cmd: guess noted. Run answer "What are the company gym’s opening hours?" and then a handbook question.

tryNext.ui: Turn off "Cite the source" and note the warning: the answer may be right, but nobody can check it.
tryNext.cmd: Run answer --cite no and compare with --cite yes.

why.simples:
A good clerk says where the information came from ("it’s in item 3 of the handbook") and admits when they don’t know.
The assistant does the same: it answers only from the chunks, shows the chunk number and, if nothing fits, hands over to a person.
why.dev:
In the prompt: numbered chunks, an instruction to answer only from them, a citation format ([n]) and a fixed refusal sentence. In code: check that every cited [n] exists among the chunks sent, detect the refusal sentence and only show the answer if it passes.
Two gates against hallucination: before the LLM (search similarity threshold) and after (valid citation). Providers also offer native citation features, such as the Anthropic API’s Citations, which return the exact passage used.
why.especialista:
Citing doesn’t guarantee faithfulness: the model can cite [2] and say something chunk 2 doesn’t. Evaluate with a judge (LLM or human) whether each sentence is supported by the cited chunk, measuring faithfulness apart from relevance.
Calibrate refusal with real out-of-scope questions: refusing too much frustrates, too little invents HR policy. Log refusals and questions with no good chunk: they become the list of what’s missing from the docs.

mission.ui: time to break it: turn off "Refuse without basis" and ask the gym hours.
mission.cmd: time to break it: run answer "What are the company gym’s opening hours?" --refuse no

break.success: Broken: confidence was {confPct}% (below {limitPct}%) and the assistant still answered "{out}". Without a refusal instruction and gate, it fills the gap by making things up.
break.calm: Confidence {confPct}% against a {limitPct}% threshold. To break it, turn refusal off and ask something not in the handbook.

ui: Pick a question and hit Run.
"Threshold" is the minimum similarity for the assistant to answer; below it, it refuses (if refusal is on).
cmd: The question goes in quotes, after answer.
--cite and --refuse take yes or no; --threshold goes from 0.5 to 0.99.
answer "What are the company gym’s opening hours?" --refuse no

scene.label: HR assistant
scene.whyGrounded: no chunk passed the threshold and it answered anyway
scene.whyCited: the answer has no [n]; nobody can check it
scene.simNote: Simulated mode: canned answers. Use "Your key" or "In the browser" to generate with a real LLM.

chunkTexts: Vacation must be requested through the employee portal 30 days in advance and needs the manager’s approval.
Vacation can be split into up to three periods: one of at least 14 days and the others of at least 5 days each.
Employees can sell up to one third of their vacation (cash allowance), asking together with the vacation request.
The meal allowance (VR) is R$ 45 per working day; anyone may swap it for the grocery allowance (VA) of the same value.
The health plan covers spouses and children up to 24 as dependents, with co-payment on appointments.
The PLR profit share is paid in March, proportional to how well company and team goals were met the previous year.
Remote work is allowed up to 2 days a week, agreed with the manager at the start of each month.
Anyone with remote days gets a R$ 120 monthly home office allowance, paid with the salary.
Work expenses are reimbursed with an invoice uploaded in the expenses app within 30 days.
Home internet and electricity aren’t reimbursable: those costs are already covered by the home office allowance.
To change your portal password, go to My profile > Security or call IT extension 4000.
To use the VPN, install the corporate app and select the AUR-VPN-02 profile.

systems.cr: Answer in English, in one or two sentences, using only the numbered chunks. End each sentence with the chunk number in brackets, like [3]. If the chunks don’t answer, say exactly: "I couldn’t find that in the handbook. I’ll forward your question to HR."

steps: Build a prompt with 3 numbered chunks from a document of yours and the instruction "answer only from the chunks, cite [n] and, if there’s no answer, say exactly: I couldn’t find it".
Ask 3 questions the chunks answer and 2 they don’t, on an LLM with your key.
In code, extract the [n] with a regular expression and check that each number is among the chunks sent.
recipe.ok: the 3 answers carry valid [n] and the 2 off-topic questions get the refusal sentence, with no made-up information.
